text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّن نَّزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ

words.gloss_range: resumptive and coordinating opener that carries the prior provision claim into a fresh interrogation scene
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) links 29:63 back to the provision claim in 29:62 while also launching a new proof-scene. Its single-letter form is visibly bound to the oath-conditional opening, so continuation and cross-examination arrive as one compressed start.

topics.headline: continuation into a new proof-scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah continues the prior provision argument while opening a fresh interrogation.
topics.reason: The opener is compatible with both conjunction and resumption, and the surrounding discourse moves from provision doctrine in 29:62 into the test scene.

topics.headline: single-letter compression before oath-condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the boundary link and oath-conditional pressure compressed into the first written cluster.
topics.reason: The particle is a proclitic attached before the oath-conditional opening.

words.gloss_range: preparatory oath-lam before the conditional, charging the condition before the question unfolds
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is the first pressure point in the oath-conditional frame. It makes the coming question feel already secured and waits across the rain-and-revival evidence until the matching answer-lam appears at word 17.

topics.headline: preparatory oath-lam before the condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that certainty is loaded before the question even begins.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as the preparatory lam before the conditional, and the later answer-lam confirms the frame.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle governing the hypothetical asking and waiting for the emphatic answer
words.prose: {{ar:ئِنْ}} ({{tr:ʾin}}) turns the scene into a controlled condition: if the Prophet were to ask them. The point is diagnostic rather than informational, since the structure is built to extract the answer they are bound to give.

topics.headline: conditional frame for an extractive question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question is staged to expose a concession, not to seek unknown information.
topics.reason: The conditional governs the asking and waits for the emphatic answer, making the exchange hypothetical and controlled.

words.gloss_range: hypothetical second-person asking with attached plural object, used as diagnostic interrogation rather than information-seeking
words.root_gloss_range: asking, requesting, demanding, and accountability; here the speech-act is a targeted question that makes the respondents answerable
words.prose: {{ar:سَأَلْتَهُمْ}} ({{tr:saʾaltahum}}) is perfect in form but hypothetical under the condition: if you were to ask them. The attached plural object makes the respondents immediately targeted, and the asking becomes forensic, pressing the same group from question to confession to the final reasoning verdict.

topics.headline: hypothetical asking with fixed respondents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the respondents are fixed inside a reusable hypothetical test.
topics.reason: The perfect verb is governed by the condition, and the attached object suffix marks the questioned group.

topics.headline: questioning as cross-examination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their own answer becomes evidence against their later failure to reason.
topics.reason: The embedded question and predicted apodosis form a recurrent challenge pattern also visible at 29:61, 31:25, and 43:9.

words.gloss_range: interrogative agent-pronoun opening the embedded question
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) asks for the agent, not the manner or timing of rain. By serving as the subject of the descent verb, it opens a slot that the later answer fills directly with the confessed divine agent.

topics.headline: interrogative subject opening the agent slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah asks who performs the act, forcing an agent confession.
topics.reason: The interrogative pronoun is the subject of the descent verb and is answered by the later nominative divine name.

words.gloss_range: Form II completed sending-down of water, locally a staged or intensive descent within the rain proof
words.root_gloss_range: descent and sending down, with a nearby prepared-provision branch that may color but not replace the local rain sense
words.prose: {{ar:نَزَّلَ}} ({{tr:nazzala}}) makes the first action inside the embedded question a Form II descent, suited to staged or repeated sending down. The root's prepared-provision associations let the rain feel delivered as provision, while the local object keeps the sense anchored in water descending from the sky.

topics.headline: Form II staged descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rain is framed as intensified or staged sending down, not a bare fall.
topics.reason: The local form is Form II perfect and governs a source phrase and object.

topics.headline: descent as delivered provision within the rain chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices provision delivered from above, while the grammar keeps the local sense to sending down water.
topics.reason: The prepared-provision branch and rain motif are relevant as color and comparison, including 16:65, 2:22, 31:10, and the opposite-valence descent from sky in 29:34, but the object here is water.

words.gloss_range: source preposition marking the sky as origin of the descent
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) supplies the source relation for the descent verb. It makes the skyward domain the origin point of the water, so the proof depends on a movement from above to below rather than on water merely existing.

topics.headline: sky as source rather than setting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a descent vector with an origin point before the object arrives.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following sky noun and attaches to the descent verb as source/origin.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive upper domain governed by the source preposition
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, and the upper domain; local syntax selects the sky as source while preserving rain-associated pressure only as enrichment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَآءِ}} ({{tr:al-samāʾi}}) is genitive after the source preposition and names the familiar upper domain. Its height-root keeps the proof vertical, while the broader rain use of the word is only a controlled resonance because an explicit water object follows.

topics.headline: definite upper source in the vertical proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the proof moving from the familiar upper realm toward the lower earth.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and genitive after the source preposition, and the sky-earth pairing is a major vertical axis.

topics.headline: rain resonance inside the sky word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices rain-pressure in the source word, while the following explicit water object keeps sky as the selected local reference.
topics.reason: The supplied semantics allow rain usage, but local syntax names the upper source before an explicit water object.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative water as the delivered object and later instrument of revival
words.root_gloss_range: water and fluid/essence fields; local syntax selects rain-water as the object of sending down
words.prose: {{ar:مَآءً}} ({{tr:māʾan}}) is the indefinite accusative payload of the descent: water, not an abstract provision term. Its indefiniteness lets any reviving instance count, and the later instrumental pronoun keeps this water active as the means by which the earth is revived. The word also carries a fluid life-medium pressure and echoes the final sound of the preceding al-samāʾi, while the local syntax keeps ordinary rain-water primary.

topics.headline: indefinite water payload that remains instrumental
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that abstract provision has become a concrete water payload that continues into the revival clause.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite accusative object of the descent verb, and the later pronoun resumes it as instrument.

topics.headline: water field and local sound echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the fluid life-medium field and source-object sound echo, while local syntax keeps ordinary rain-water primary.
topics.reason: Broader water, seminal-fluid, essence, and root-dispute claims are useful only as controlled background because this clause explicitly sends water from the sky.

words.gloss_range: sequential fāʾ moving directly from descent to revival-result
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the water clause toward consequence. The particle does not spell out a full causal explanation, but its immediate sequencing makes the revived earth the next result in the same proof-chain.

topics.headline: immediate movement from descent to revival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the delivered water is immediately turned toward its life-result.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the revival clause after the descent clause with sequential or consequential force.

words.gloss_range: Form IV causative revival, with God as implicit agent and the earth as object
words.root_gloss_range: life, liveliness, and vitality; local form selects causative reviving of deadened earth
words.prose: {{ar:أَحْيَا}} ({{tr:aḥyā}}) is Form IV, so life is externally caused rather than simply possessed. It gathers the sent water, the instrumental pronoun, and the earth into one revival span, and its life-root stands in direct antithesis to the death named at word 16. Wider vitality and the next-ayah life contrast (29:64) remain resonance, but the local action is physical earth-revival.

topics.headline: external causation of life
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices life being caused by an implied divine agent through the sent water.
topics.reason: The Form IV verb has God as implicit subject and gathers water, instrument, and earth object into one causal span.

topics.headline: life over against the earth death-state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the life-death reversal in the clause, while wider vitality and next-ayah life language remain supporting resonance.
topics.reason: The local clause explicitly contrasts reviving with death; broader vitality fields and the 29:64 life contrast are relevant but do not replace the physical earth-revival sense.

words.gloss_range: instrumental bāʾ with pronoun, resuming the water as means of revival
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) with its pronoun makes the water the instrument of revival. The small preposition prevents the descent from being a detached sign: the delivered object becomes the means by which the earth is brought back to life.

topics.headline: water as means of revival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the water does work inside the proof instead of remaining a detached sign.
topics.reason: The preposition governs a pronoun referring back to water and marks instrumentality for the revival verb.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative earth as the receiving object of revival
words.root_gloss_range: earth, ground, and the lower receiving domain; local syntax makes it the patient of causative life
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضَ}} ({{tr:al-ʾarḍa}}) is the direct object of the revival verb, the receiving ground acted on by the sent water. Its definiteness makes the lower terrestrial domain recognizable, completing the vertical movement from sky source to earth recipient.

topics.headline: earth as definite receiving object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the lower earth as the patient that receives water and life after the sky-source clause.
topics.reason: The noun is definite accusative as object of the revival verb and completes the sky-to-earth movement.

words.gloss_range: temporal-ablative min opening the after-death frame
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) reuses a from-relation temporally. After the earth-object has been named, it opens the point of departure from which revival is measured: after its death.

topics.headline: from-relation reused for after-death time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the revival is measured from a prior death-state.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following after-noun and marks a temporal point of departure.

words.gloss_range: genitive construct head meaning after, bound to the earth death phrase
words.root_gloss_range: distance, remoteness, and laterness; local form converts distance into temporal after-ness
words.prose: {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}) is a construct head bound to the following death phrase. The distance-root makes after feel like movement away from a prior state, so revival is heard as crossing out of death rather than merely occurring later.

topics.headline: bound after-phrase as temporal distance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices after-ness as a bound temporal distance away from the named death-state.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the preposition and is construct-bound to the following possessed death noun.

words.gloss_range: possessed death-state of the earth, genitive after after
words.root_gloss_range: death, inertness, cessation, and shutdown; local phrase applies it metaphorically to barren earth
words.prose: {{ar:مَوْتِهَا}} ({{tr:mawtihā}}) gives the earth a possessed death-state through the feminine suffix. The wording is not biological death of a creature but barren cessation, and the suffix keeps the earlier earth present without repeating it. That shutdown state is the named opposite that the revival verb reverses.

topics.headline: possessed death-state of the earth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth carries a prior state, not just a location in a scene.
topics.reason: The feminine suffix refers back to the earth, and the noun is the genitive complement of the after-construct.

topics.headline: death field inside the life-death reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shutdown-to-life polarity, while local context keeps the death metaphor tied to barren earth.
topics.reason: The m-w-t field includes inertness and cessation; 29:57 contrasts human death, but here the suffix and earth referent keep the sense to land-death.

words.gloss_range: answer-lam introducing the emphatic apodosis after the long question
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) closes the frame opened by the first lam. After the question has carried the reader through descent, water, and revived earth, this second lam marks the answer as the guaranteed apodosis.

topics.headline: emphatic answer to the oath-condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the delayed lock between the opening condition and the guaranteed confession.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the conditional apodosis and fuses to the following emphatic speech verb.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural speech verb with heavy energetic nun, predicting their certain confession
words.root_gloss_range: saying and verbal acknowledgment; local contrast shows speech without the reasoning demanded later
words.prose: {{ar:يَقُولُنَّ}} ({{tr:yaqūlunna}}) makes their response a certain future confession, intensified by the heavy energetic ending. The plural subject continues the questioned group, but the root of saying remains only speech; the ayah will soon distinguish it from reasoning.

topics.headline: certain plural speech response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their confession is predicted with certainty after the evidence has been staged.
topics.reason: The imperfect plural with heavy energetic nun forms the oath-marked answer to the condition.

topics.headline: saying contrasted with understanding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that correct utterance is not the same as cognitive commitment.
topics.reason: The speech verb precedes the commanded counter-speech and the final reasoning negation.

words.gloss_range: nominative divine name as the one-word answer to the agent question
words.root_gloss_range: divinity, worship, awe, and debated derivational associations; locally the proper name supplies the confessed agent
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) fills the agent slot opened by the question. As a nominative one-word answer, it confesses the agent of sending down and reviving, then stands ready to be transformed from confessed agent into recipient of praise. Worship and awe associations may enrich that pivot, but the local job remains the direct answer to the agent-question.

topics.headline: one-word divine agent answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the answer fills the agent slot directly and minimally.
topics.reason: The proper noun is nominative as the answer to the earlier agent question.

topics.headline: divine name pivoting toward praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same name moving from confessed agent toward praise-recipient, while derivational disputes remain secondary.
topics.reason: The local role is the proper divine name as answer; worship and awe derivational fields enrich the pivot but do not alter the parse.

words.gloss_range: imperative speech command redirecting the response to the Prophet
words.root_gloss_range: saying and commanded utterance; locally an imperative counter-speech after their predicted speech
words.prose: {{ar:قُلِ}} ({{tr:quli}}) shifts from their predicted saying to a commanded prophetic reply. Its imperative form makes praise a required response, and the liaison vowel shows the command moving directly into the praise clause.

topics.headline: imperative reply after their saying
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Prophet is commanded to supply the proper response to their confession.
topics.reason: The imperative redirects speech after their predicted answer; 29:52 offers another prophetic command anchored in divine sufficiency.

topics.headline: quli liaison into the praise clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command moving phonologically straight into the praise phrase.
topics.reason: The kasra resolves liaison before the following definite praise noun.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative verbal noun for praise as a stable nominal claim
words.root_gloss_range: praise and commendation for worth, broader than transactional thanks; local clause assigns praise to God
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَمْدُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥamdu}}) is definite and nominative, heading a nominal sentence rather than a bare command to praise. The familiar al-ḥamdu lillāhi formula (1:2, 6:1, 34:1, 35:1) is deployed mid-ayah, while the canonical nominative keeps the local syntax a stable praise claim and the genitive variant only marks a pressure point. It turns the confessed agent into the proper recipient of all praise, so the proof demands evaluative acknowledgment, not just correct naming.

topics.headline: definite nominative praise as stable assignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the response is a stable claim that praise itself belongs to God.
topics.reason: The word is a definite nominative verbal noun heading a nominal sentence, with hamd distinguished from mere transactional thanks.

topics.headline: formula and case-variant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the familiar praise formula deployed mid-ayah, while the canonical nominative still governs this output.
topics.reason: The genitive variant shows syntactic pressure, but the local canonical form is nominative; the formula is familiar from 1:2, 6:1, 34:1, and 35:1.

topics.headline: praise inserted between confession and verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that praise is the inference their correct answer should have produced.
topics.reason: The praise clause stands between their confession and the correction, making the final indictment a failure to bind confession to worshipful acknowledgment.

words.gloss_range: dedicatory or possessive lam assigning praise to God
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is the pivot that assigns praise to God. It links the praise noun to its exclusive recipient, and in pronunciation and writing it fuses into the divine name so belonging-to-God becomes the visible shape of the phrase.

topics.headline: lam assigning praise to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammatical mechanism that moves praise from an abstract noun to its proper recipient.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the divine name and forms the predicate relation of the nominal praise sentence.

words.gloss_range: genitive divine name governed by li as praise-recipient
words.root_gloss_range: divinity, worship, awe, and debated derivational associations; locally the name is the genitive recipient-owner of praise
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) is the same divine name in a new role: genitive after the dedicatory lam rather than nominative answer. The shift from confessed agent to owner and destination of praise is carried by case and contraction. Worship, awe, and bewilderment fields converge on the praise-recipient as enrichment, without changing the genitive relation.

topics.headline: same name as genitive owner of praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the role shift from nominative confessed agent to genitive praise-recipient.
topics.reason: The name is genitive after the lam, unlike the earlier nominative answer.

topics.headline: divine-name derivation enriches recipient role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices worship and awe fields converging on the praise recipient, while the local case role remains genitive after the preposition.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is useful semantic enrichment but does not change the local syntactic relation.

words.gloss_range: corrective bal turning from proper praise to the deeper cognition failure
words.prose: {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) refuses to let correct confession and commanded praise end the argument. It pivots into correction: the issue is not that they cannot say the right answer, but that most of them do not bind the answer into understanding.

topics.headline: bal exposes the speech-cognition split
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that correct speech is not allowed to count as reasoning.
topics.reason: The adversative particle scopes over the final negated cognition clause and turns from confession and praise to correction.

words.gloss_range: elative-plus-suffix majority expression, binding the verdict to the same respondents without universalizing it
words.root_gloss_range: abundance, increase, and majority; local elative selects the dominant portion rather than every individual
words.prose: {{ar:أَكْثَرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:ʾaktharuhum}}) makes the final verdict careful rather than total. The elative form marks the majority, and the attached plural suffix ties that majority back to the respondents who just gave the correct answer. Its increase-field gives the majority a crowd-weight, while the same quantified indictment also appears at 8:34 and 49:4 and the same group remains in view at 29:67.

topics.headline: majority verdict tied to the same respondents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a carefully bounded indictment of most respondents, not a universal statement about every individual.
topics.reason: The elative form with the attached plural suffix functions as the subject of the final negated predicate and keeps the verdict tied to the earlier group.

topics.headline: mass-preponderance and formulaic indictment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices crowd-weight in the majority term, while local grammar keeps it a bounded proportion.
topics.reason: The broader increase field colors the majority sense; the formula also appears at 8:34 and 49:4, and 29:67 keeps the same group in view.

words.gloss_range: negation particle before the imperfect reasoning verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the final cognition verb directly. The verdict is not weak reasoning or incomplete reasoning; in the surface grammar, the majority are not engaging the act of reasoning.

topics.headline: negator over the reasoning verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing verdict denies the act of reasoning itself.
topics.reason: The negation particle immediately precedes the imperfect reasoning verb inside the corrective clause.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural reasoning verb under negation, closing on ongoing failure to bind facts into judgment
words.root_gloss_range: binding, tethering, and reasoning; local form presents reasoning as an ongoing group act they fail to perform
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْقِلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿqilūna}}) closes the ayah on the missing operation. Under negation, the imperfect plural presents an ongoing failure to bind the data together: question, rain, revived earth, confession, and praise are all available, but most do not tether them into understanding. That failed binding becomes the human analogue to the earlier dead-earth image, with reasoning affirmed for sign-readers in 29:35.

topics.headline: imperfect plural failure to reason
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verdict as ongoing group failure rather than one missed inference.
topics.reason: The imperfect plural verb agrees with the quantified majority and remains verbal rather than becoming an abstract noun.

topics.headline: reasoning as binding the proof together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the missing act is binding correct confession to the evidence and its required praise.
topics.reason: The root field supports binding as a cognition image; 29:35 contrasts affirmed reasoning, and the reasoning-life link makes the final failure mirror the earlier dead-earth image.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from the sender-question through their answer at 29:63.14-15 to the commanded praise at 16-18 and the adversative diagnosis at 19-22.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question forces attribution of a delivered, life-producing benefit. Their spoken answer supplies the correct agent, but the command converts attribution into evaluative gratitude; the closing denial of reason locates the failure in binding the admitted cause to its due response.

activation_trace.role: Delivery and arrival from above supply the causal act whose agent the question asks them to identify.
Rain-caused life in the earth supplies an observable benefit rather than an abstract claim.
Spoken utterance carries both their compelled answer and the commanded corrective response.
Praise as the opposite of blame and as gratitude for benefit names the response the admission should yield.
Reason as a restraint from ignorance supplies the missing inferential binding between answer and praise.

changed_reading.before: The ayah asks a creation question, receives the correct answer, and then adds a general formula of praise.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages an incomplete inference: they correctly identify the giver of a publicly experienced benefit, yet most do not bind that attribution into gratitude and allegiance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal and temporal construction at 29:63.4-13: water is delivered, the earth is made alive by it, and this occurs after its death.
baseline_models.mechanism: Delivered water changes the lower, cultivable earth from nonproductive death to rain-life. The explicit 'after' makes revival a sequenced reversal of state, so apparent terrestrial death is presented as penetrable rather than terminal.

activation_trace.role: Water conveyed by pouring or irrigation supplies the material mediator of the transition.
The branch directly identifies the earth's life through rain and vegetation as the resulting state.
Soft, growth-bearing earth supplies the recipient whose productive capacity is restored.
Temporal succession after what came before makes death and renewed life ordered phases.
Dead uncultivated land supplies a concrete death-state that rain can reverse.

changed_reading.after: The focus ayah presents an observable state-reversal: a materially dead and unproductive earth receives a mediator and crosses back into life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tension between emphatic 'they will surely say Allah' and 'rather, most of them do not reason.'
baseline_models.mechanism: The saying-root can denote an emitted utterance or a held position. The ayah grants the utterance but withholds rational integration; the majority marker makes this a population-wide asymmetry between available proposition and governing conviction.

activation_trace.role: Audible saying establishes that the correct proposition is actually articulated.
Saying as belief or position supplies the stronger integration that an emitted answer does not by itself prove.
Numerical predominance makes the disconnect the condition of most respondents, not an exceptional lapse.
Understanding and self-restraint name the absent uptake of what their mouths already concede.

changed_reading.before: Answering 'Allah' indicates that the respondents possess the relevant belief.
changed_reading.after: Their mouths possess the proposition, but the proposition has not become a reasoned, restraining position for most of them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens by refusing to treat 'we believe' as self-validating speech: testing assays the claim, and truth is completed in action. Later, speech changes with harm and anticipated victory. This revises the focus answer from evidence of settled belief into an untested confession whose practical truth remains unproved.

activation_trace.role: The focus grants an emphatic spoken answer but then denies the reasoning that should govern conduct.
The voiced claim 'we believe' supplies the surah's initial example of speech awaiting verification.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the mechanism that reveals the quality hidden behind a claim.
Truth realized by fulfilling promise and deed supplies the criterion that mere attribution lacks.
Repeated utterance at profession and expected advantage models speech whose content follows conditions.

structural_cues: 29:2 places saying 'we believe' before testing, and 29:3 contrasts those proved true with liars.
29:10 repeats saying at initial profession and at anticipated victory; 29:63 similarly places emphatic speech before an adverse cognitive verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tested professions and condition-sensitive speech; I infer an analogous distance between 29:63's correct answer and durable allegiance. A live alternative is that the answer is sincere but practically unintegrated rather than deceptive.

changed_reading.before: The focus respondents count as believers at the level relevant to the question because their answer is correct.
changed_reading.after: Their answer is a confession awaiting the surah's assay: only gratitude, worship, and conduct could turn correct speech into demonstrated truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier provision argument denies rival objects any ownership of sustenance and joins seeking provision from Allah to serving and thanking him. Because the provision branch itself includes descending rain, the focus water is livelihood delivered; 'praise belongs to Allah' states the ethical consequence of identifying its source.

activation_trace.role: Conveyed water supplies the concrete means by which provision reaches its recipients.
Praise and gratitude for a benefit supply the response demanded after the provider is named.
Submissive service contrasts powerless worshipped objects with service directed to the actual provider.
Rain descending as provision makes the focus rainfall an instance of the sustenance rivals cannot own.
Recognizing a benefit and praising its giver explicitly supplies the relational consequence of provision.

structural_cues: 29:17 moves from the inability of other objects to provide, to seeking provision with Allah, to worship and thanks.
29:63 repeats the provider-identification problem with water and then commands praise rather than stopping at the answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain as a provision branch and an explicit provision-worship-thanks sequence; I infer that the focus command completes that same ethical chain. The live alternative is that rainfall functions primarily as a resurrection proof, with gratitude secondary.

changed_reading.before: The rainfall example proves divine power and the praise command is a devotional appendix.
changed_reading.after: Rain is delivered livelihood, so naming Allah as its source disqualifies nonproviding rivals and obliges gratitude and service; praise is the conclusion of the provision argument.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier commands make observed terrestrial processes evidence for beginning creation and repeating it; nearby, every self tastes death and returns, while the verse immediately after the focus distinguishes present life from definitive life. Dead-earth revival therefore becomes an experiential hinge from origination through death to renewed, fuller life.

activation_trace.role: Earth's rain-life supplies the repeatable observed transition on which the larger analogy turns.
Dead land supplies a concrete intermediate state that visibly does not end the sequence.
Beginning explicitly paired with return supplies the creation-recreation frame.
Return after departure supplies the directional move from first creation to repetition.
Directing sight and insight to the earth supplies the instructed empirical route to that conclusion.
Universal loss of life transfers the death term from land to every self before return.
Living existence in both present life and intensified true life supplies the scale beyond seasonal vegetation.
Diversion from another object prevents the revived present world from being mistaken for the final referent.

structural_cues: 29:19-20 pair first creation with repetition and command observation in the earth.
29:57 states universal death and return; 29:63 revives earth after death; 29:64 immediately contrasts present life with the life of the final abode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the origin-return instruction and the local death-life sequence; I supply the analogical arrow from recurrent terrestrial revival to personal recreation and fuller life. The materially live alternative is a general sign of power without a precise resurrection analogy.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes only seasonal agricultural recovery.
changed_reading.after: Seasonal recovery is a visible rehearsal of the surah's larger route from first creation through death and return, while the next verse prevents this temporary revival from being confused with definitive life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same descent branch carries three different payloads through the surah: punishment to a corrupt settlement, scripture to an addressee, and water to dead earth. Their outcomes expose reception: land responds to delivered water with life, while most humans can identify the sender yet fail to assimilate the implication of delivered sign and mercy.

activation_trace.role: The focus realizes divine delivery as water whose arrival produces life.
The earth's successful rain-response supplies one recipient-outcome in the delivery matrix.
The same delivery branch carries a punitive payload from above to a settlement.
The same branch delivers the book, adding a verbal rather than hydrological payload.
Repeated book-delivery, locally called mercy and reminder, sharpens the beneficial parallel with rain.

structural_cues: 29:34 uses descent for punishment from the sky; 29:47 and 29:51 use it for the book; 29:63 uses it for water from the sky.
29:51 names the delivered book mercy and reminder, while 29:63 names the delivered water's outcome as life and then faults failed reasoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated delivery root and contrasting payloads; I infer recipient response as their common diagnostic axis. Alternatively, the repetition may establish only divine agency, without implying that an unreasoning mind is figuratively dead ground.

changed_reading.before: The rain descent is an isolated natural-theology example.
changed_reading.after: It completes a surah-wide grammar of delivered interventions: punishment destroys, scripture addresses, and water revives, making humanity's failure to respond more striking than the earth's reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spider-house passage presents a material relation as a parable of misplaced reliance and then says such parables are reasoned by knowers. The focus likewise offers a material relation, water reviving dependent earth. Its closing denial of reason now specifies failure to transfer an observed dependency into a judgment about worship, gratitude, and reliance.

activation_trace.role: Reason as understanding and restraint is the focus faculty whose failed operation requires specification.
A parable functioning as lesson and sign turns a material arrangement into guidance about reliance.
Weakness of strength supplies the concrete property transferred from a house to false protection.
The explicit class of instructive parables supplies the context for analogical rather than merely factual reasoning.
Reasoning the parables identifies rational work as binding visible image to its governing implication.
Disclosure to the knower marks successful uptake of what the material comparison reveals.

structural_cues: 29:41 gives the weak house as a material analogy for taking protectors; 29:43 explicitly assigns grasp of such analogies to reasoning knowers.
29:63 gives another observable material dependency and contrasts correct source-attribution with failure to reason.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit parable-reason relation and a focus material sequence; I infer that 29:63 asks for the same transfer from ecology to allegiance. A live alternative is that 'do not reason' denotes general incomprehension rather than specifically failed analogy.

changed_reading.before: The respondents fail to understand a simple causal fact even though they answer it correctly.
changed_reading.after: They know the causal fact but fail at the surah's characteristic rational operation: carrying a visible dependency across domains into restraint, gratitude, and reliable worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to inhabit God's spacious earth is followed by trust and by creatures that do not transport their own stores yet are provisioned. Rain delivered to revive dead land supplies an ecological mechanism for portable dependence: provision can meet creatures across the earth because it is sent, not secured only by what they carry or where they remain.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from elsewhere supplies the mobility of provision toward a needy place.
Growth-bearing earth supplies the destination whose livelihood can be renewed.
Spatial openness against constriction supplies the field across which worshippers may move.
Reliance supplies the posture required when livelihood is not secured by staying or carrying.
Visible load-bearing makes the creature's non-carrying of its provision a concrete logistical condition.
Allotted giving supplies the provision that reaches both creatures and addressees.

structural_cues: 29:56 calls God's earth spacious and commands exclusive worship; 29:59 names reliance; 29:60 says many creatures do not carry their provision.
29:63 then depicts water being delivered to a needy patch of earth and restoring its productive life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a migration-shaped spatial command followed by trust, non-carrying creatures, and delivered rain; I infer that the ecological sequence answers livelihood anxiety under mobility. Alternatively, these may be adjacent general assurances without a specific migration logistics claim.

changed_reading.before: The rainfall example is addressed only to settled observers of a familiar landscape.
changed_reading.after: The rain cycle also becomes reassurance for mobile dependents: the provider can send livelihood across a spacious earth, so faithful movement need not be governed by carried stores or attachment to one place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus repeats the preceding verse's question-answer frame. Creation and cosmic ordering, differentiated provision, and rain-driven revival form one admitted system. The paired verdicts, being turned away and not reasoning, show a reversal away from the respondents' own causal account rather than lack of access to that account.

activation_trace.role: Questioning elicits the admitted source of the rain-revival process.
The emphatic answer repeats the prior response while the second speech act commands its consequence.
The matching question initiates the immediate paired interrogation.
Origination of the heavens and earth supplies the system's foundational act.
Being turned from a proper direction names movement away from the answer they have just supplied.
Expansion and increase supply one direction of the provider's differentiated allocation.
Allotted provision connects cosmic control in 29:61 to the rain-mediated benefit in 29:63.

structural_cues: 29:61 and 29:63 share the conditional question, emphatic answer, and 'Allah' response almost as a paired frame.
29:62 sits between them with expansion and restriction of provision; 29:61 ends with diversion and 29:63 with failed reasoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated syntax and intervening provision statement; I infer one cumulative system whose admitted premises should govern response. Alternatively, the two questions may be parallel independent proofs rather than steps in one syllogism.

changed_reading.before: The focus records one isolated inconsistency about rain.
changed_reading.after: It is the second deposition in a cumulative system they already concede: origin, ordering, allocation, and revival all point to the same agent, so their diversion contradicts their own repeated account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, danger produces exclusive invocation, but rescue is followed by association; the next verses describe covering what was given and denying a secure blessing. Praise in the focus therefore becomes a practice of retaining the giver through changed conditions, opposing the recurrent transition from received benefit to source-amnesia.

activation_trace.role: Grateful praise supplies the durable response meant to follow recognized benefit.
Restraining understanding supplies continuity between recognition and later conduct.
Calling by directed speech externalizes recognition when danger removes competing supports.
Exclusive separation from association supplies the crisis-state of undivided allegiance.
Rescue by separation supplies the benefit after which the posture is tested.
Association with Allah supplies the immediate reversal once safety returns.
Covering a benefit names the forgetting response opposed to grateful praise.
A good condition and blessing supplies the stable security that is nevertheless denied.

structural_cues: 29:65 moves from exclusive invocation at sea to association immediately after rescue on land.
29:66 describes covering what was given; 29:67 contrasts belief in falsehood with denial of Allah's blessing, directly after 29:63 commands praise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the immediate danger-rescue-reversion and blessing-denial sequence; I infer that praise is the focus's counter-practice of durable remembrance. A live alternative is that the later pronouns illustrate a related group pattern rather than the exact respondents of 29:63.

changed_reading.before: The praise command is a brief liturgical response to rainfall.
changed_reading.after: Praise is the demanded memory discipline that should carry correct recognition beyond the moment of evidence or danger and block the slide from benefit into association and denial.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The judicial overlay is surprising because 29:63 is not explicitly a judgment scene. It remains valid as an exploratory activation because 29:13 uses the same question branch in an emphatic future passive about their fabrications, while 29:63 elicits an answer that can stand against those fabrications. Render as 'rehearses' or 'can function like a deposition,' not as an assertion that the two scenes are identical.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The question at 29:63.2 elicits a conceded answer from the very respondents whose reasoning is then faulted.

activation_trace.role: Direct questioning requests the admission that becomes available as testimony.
Their emitted answer supplies the verbal record on which the accountability image depends.
Future questioning about fabrication supplies the surah's explicit accountability frame for the repeated act.

changed_reading.before: The question is only a pedagogical prompt proving that the respondents know the creator.
changed_reading.after: The prompt can also be heard as a miniature pre-judgment deposition: their truthful answer is self-witness against fabricated alternatives and makes nonresponse culpable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of the sky root to W-S-M and crosses from meteorology into inscription. It remains anchored because that supplied branch specifically pictures first rain marking earth with vegetation, exactly the focus result, and 29:44 calls creation a visible sign. Downstream prose should call it a branch-triggered signature image, not an etymology of 'sky.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sky-water-earth-life chain at 29:63.6-10 makes the effect of rain visible on the recipient surface.

activation_trace.role: First rain that marks earth with vegetation supplies a signature-like image within the focus chain.
Rain-life and vegetation are the visible content of the mark.
Growth-bearing earth supplies the surface on which the mark appears.
A manifest sign supplies the surah's category for reading a visible created effect.

changed_reading.before: Water descends from the sky and causes growth.
changed_reading.after: The rain can be imaged as inscribing the sender's visible signature on earth in vegetation; they read the signature well enough to name Allah but do not let it bind them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant Q-L-L branch under the written saying-root. It remains visibly anchored in the singular imperative 'qul' beside 'most of them,' creating a real formal contrast. Render only as a sonic or branch-level counterpoint: the text still means 'say,' and the fewness image must not replace its morphology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The singular command at 29:63.16-18 is followed immediately by the numerical majority at 20 and their failure to reason.

activation_trace.role: Fewness against abundance gives the singular commanded utterance a minority-countervoice image.
Praise supplies the content voiced by that counter-position.
Numerical increase supplies the explicit majority against which the singular praise stands.

changed_reading.before: The command simply tells the messenger to utter praise before describing an unreasoning majority.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory branch level, the singular praise sounds like a deliberately small counter-utterance set against the numerical weight of an unreasoning majority.

strongest_changes: The correct answer became untested and unintegrated speech rather than sufficient belief.
Rain became delivered provision whose admitted source demands gratitude, exclusive service, and trust.
Dead-earth revival became an empirical hinge from first creation and universal death toward return and definitive life.
Repeated N-Z-L formed a delivery matrix of punishment, scripture, and water, making the earth's successful reception contrast with failed human uptake.
The immediate sea-rescue and sanctuary sequence made praise a durable antidote to benefit-amnesia.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context turned 'they do not reason' from generic ignorance into failure to bind a repeatedly admitted causal system to tested truth, analogical transfer, mobile reliance, gratitude, and conduct. Non-dominant packet branches also preserved rain-as-signature and minority-praise images without promoting them to lexical claims.
remaining_uncertainties: The resurrection reading is strongly activated by sequence and analogy, but the focus itself can remain a general proof of power.
The delivery matrix clearly repeats the descent root; the further contrast between receptive earth and cognitively unreceptive humans is reader-supplied.
The mobile-provision reading depends on treating the spacious-earth, trust, creature-provision, and rain sequence as an answer to livelihood anxiety.
The respondents' answer may be opportunistic, sincere but unintegrated, or both across different people; the packet does not force one psychology.
The split-root outliers are diagnostic word-images and should not be rendered as historical derivations or primary meanings.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Water makes causal recognition visible but not yet binding.** م و ه B002 is water appearing, entering, or becoming abundant, and B006 is a watery sheen of freshness. Descent → water → revived earth supplies an observable chain, and the respondents correctly name God yet fail to reason. I infer that visible freshness should carry recognition into praise and orientation; the ayah reads their answer as cognitively incomplete because they name the source without binding the causal relation to conduct.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:64's contrast between diverted near life and the truly living abode reveals what the revived earth was pointing beyond itself toward. Ecological revival becomes a reasoning bridge to durable life.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Rain stages a visible miniature of life after death.** Lexical evidence: `نَزَّل`, root `ن ز ل`, `B002` (sending down); `ٱلسَّمَاء`, root `س م و`, `B004` (overhead sky and cover); `مَاء`, root `م و ه`, `B001` (water itself); `فَأَحْيَا`, root `ح ي ي`, `B002` (earth brought alive by rain and growth); `ٱلْأَرْض`, root `ء ر ض`, `B001` (lower ground); `بَعْد`, root `ب ع د`, `B002` (afterness); and `مَوْتِهَا`, root `م و ت`, `B003` (dead land). Structural cue: the explicit vertical flow produces life after terrestrial death; `29:57-58` have just placed death before return and inhabited garden. Assigned role: water is the material mediator; afterness orders revival after deadness. Abductive move: I infer an analogy from ecological renewal to personal return, not identity of mechanism. Reading change: ordinary rain becomes inspectable evidence that “after death” can be a productive sequence.

2. **Praise is the warranted inference that understanding should bind into conduct.** Lexical evidence: `ٱلْحَمْد`, root `ح م د`, `B002` (finding something praiseworthy or satisfactory); `أَكْثَرُهُم`, root `ك ث ر`, `B001` (numerical abundance); and `يَعْقِلُون`, root `ع ق ل`, `B001` (understanding as restraint from ignorance). Structural cue: they correctly answer “God,” the speaker draws the praiseworthy conclusion, then `بَل` corrects the majority's failure of restraint. Assigned role: praise is the evaluative consequence of the admitted causal chain; understanding should tether action to it. Abductive move: I infer that the missing step is not factual recognition but binding the recognized provider to exclusive gratitude and worship. Reading change: praise becomes reason's practical conclusion, and lack of reason is failure to live by one's answer.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later activation (`29:64`):** The very next ayah calls the later abode the true animate life. This retrospectively makes rain-revival more than agricultural recovery: it is a local, visible grammar of “life after death” that points beyond itself to the later life's fuller order.

baseline.text: Onlara, "Gökten suyu kim indirdi ve ölümünün ardından yeryüzünü onunla kim canlandırdı?" diye sorsan mutlaka, "Allah" derler. De ki: "Övgü Allah'adır." Fakat onların çoğu aklını kullanmaz.

findings.text: Gökten inen suyun ölü yeri yeniden canlandırması, ölümden sonra hayatın mümkün oluşunu gözlenebilir küçük bir süreç halinde gösterir.
“Allah” diye doğru cevap verdikten sonra övgüye ve doğru yönelişe geçmemek, bilginin davranışı bağlayan sonucunu kuramayan eksik bir akıl yürütmedir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Life moves through loss, return, descending water, and renewed circulation rather than remaining a self-sustaining possession.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Mortality and revival become a hydraulic cycle of exhausted substrate, delivered water, open channels, organic yield, and restored circulation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Life-Bearing Self, Death, and Return
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A living self loses force, passes through a death-state, experiences it directly, and is returned toward its source.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: loss of life and force `quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`; lifeless land or object `quranic:root_001454:B003/m01`; stillness and wearing out `quranic:root_001454:B012/m01`; life-bearing self `quranic:root_001533:B011/m01`; the thing's own identity `quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`; return to an earlier source or condition `quranic:root_000544:B001/m01`; living creature and animated life `quranic:root_000383:B003/m01`; experiential tasting and trial `quranic:root_000526:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Death takes the force from the very self that constituted living identity, not from an expendable exterior. "Tasting" makes mortality experiential, while return prevents that loss of force from being the route's final direction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Directed Channels and Continuous Yield
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water is admitted into a measured channel, cuts a course through earth, and sustains continuing growth and allotment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: directing water into a channel `quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`; emergence of crop, fruit, and abundant water `quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`; river cutting through ground `quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`; opening and widening a course `quranic:root_001559:B003/m01`; flowing water and rivers `quranic:root_000240:B001/m01`; continuing provision or endowment `quranic:root_000240:B006/m01`; palm-heart and new growth `quranic:root_001286:B006/m01`; beneficent condition and gift `quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Water becomes durable life only when routed: admission, incision, flow, and continuing yield form one irrigation process. The promised rivers and divine bounty are thereby linked to an engineered continuity rather than a static abundance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P5 (29:57-69) Prepared Shelter and Elevated Abiding
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A lasting dwelling combines protective enclosure, prepared placement, vertical refuge, and an uninterrupted life-source.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Paradise is articulated through shield, hidden heart, prepared lodging, upper-story architecture, and water drawn or flowing below.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Upper Chamber Over Flowing Provision
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A resident is placed in an upper room while water and prepared provision circulate beneath the structure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: upper room built above another level `quranic:root_001079:B002/m01`; drawing or lifting a measured portion `quranic:root_001079:B001/m01`; lower direction beneath `quranic:root_000177:B001/m01`; river cutting a watercourse `quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`; continuous flow `quranic:root_000240:B001/m01`; prepared provision for a lodger `quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`; agreeable place and pleasant stay `quranic:root_001525:B011/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The image is architectural and hydraulic: elevation protects the resident while flow below continuously supplies the site. The "room" also retains the action of scooping a portion, making lofty placement and measured receipt part of one hospitable design.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P5 (29:57-69) Fabricated Appearance Against Fitted Truth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Falsehood is made by cutting, coating, or turning material away from its proper fit; truth is what remains fixed and correctly joined.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lying becomes leatherwork, destructive cutting, counterfeit plating, false-colored cloth, and a misaligned joint.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cutting, Stitching, and Counterfeit Surface
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A maker cuts material, either repairs or damages it, then coats or colors the surface so that the finished object presents a false condition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: cutting leather for repair and stitching `quranic:root_001150:B001/m01`; destructive splitting and cutting `quranic:root_001150:B002/m01`; fabricating a lie `quranic:root_001150:B003/m01`; plating base metal with gold or silver `quranic:root_001458:B005/m01`; inventing manufactured speech `quranic:root_000434:B007/m01`; false-colored patterned cloth `quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`; lie diverted from truth `quranic:root_000041:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Fabrication is craft with an ethical fork: cutting can prepare repair, or it can rupture; coating can protect, or it can counterfeit. The false product succeeds by making surface appearance deny underlying material.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiden bilgi edinmek için ona yönelmeyi ve bir şeyi ondan istemeyi aynı dalda açıkça tanımlar. Doğrudan nesne alan kullanım istek bildirmeye, bir konu ya da kişiyle kurulan ilgeçli kullanımlar ise bilgi edinmeye yönelir; çok soran kişi ve yardım isteyen yoksul için kullanılan adlar bu eylem çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sorma ve isteme eylemlerini kapsar; istenen şeyin kendisini, isteğin karşılanmasını ve karşılıklı sormayı ayrı dallara bırakır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın eylem çekirdeğini korurken, doğrudan bir şeyi isteme ile bir konu veya kişi hakkında bilgi sorma kalıplarını ayrı uygulamalar olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye yönelerek ondan bir şey isteme ya da bir konu, nesne veya kişi hakkında bilgi edinmeye çalışma eylemidir. Doğrudan nesneli istek ve ilgeçli bilgi sorusu bu çekirdeğin farklı kuruluşlarıdır; çok soran veya yardım isteyen kişiye verilen adlar eylemden türeyen kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir muhataba yönelip bilgi edinmeye veya bir şeyi elde etmeye çalışma eylemini bildirir.
Bir şeyi doğrudan muhataptan isteme ile bir konu ya da kişi hakkında bilgi sorma, eylemin farklı söz dizimsel kuruluşlarıdır.
Çok soru soran kimse ve gereksinimini bildirerek yardım isteyen yoksul, eylemi yapan kişi olarak adlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sorma ve isteme eylemlerini birlikte verir; doğrudan nesneli kullanımda bir şey istenirken, bir konu veya kişi hakkında kurulan kullanımda bilgi aranır. Eylem adı, çok soran kimse ve yardım isteyen kişi de aynı tanıklık kümesinde yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı, bir insanın gerçekten istediği şey olarak tanımlar ve onu yalnızca zihinde tasarlanan bir dilekten ayırır. Bu nedenle dalın kimliği isteme eylemi değil, isteğin yöneldiği nesne veya karşılanması beklenen içeriktir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam, kişi tarafından istenmiş olan şeyle sınırlıdır; henüz istek olarak ortaya konmamış dilek ve isteme eyleminin kendisi kapsam dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, herhangi bir özel kalıba bağlı olmadan, kişi tarafından istenen şeyi yalın dal anlamı olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın istediği, kendisine verilmesini ya da gerçekleşmesini talep ettiği şeydir. Bir dileğe yakın olabilir, ancak burada belirleyici olan onun gerçekten istenmiş olmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin isteme eylemine konu ettiği şeyi veya karşılanmasını istediği içeriği belirtir.
Dileğe yaklaşır, fakat yalnızca tasarlanan olasılığı değil, kişi tarafından istek olarak ortaya konmuş şeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kavramı insanın istediği şey olarak tanımlar. Dilekle ortak bir arzu alanı bulunsa da, bu dalın ayırıcı sınırı söz konusu şeyin kişi tarafından gerçekten istenmiş olmasıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin açıkça istediği nesne, sonuç veya karşılanacak içerik için dalın tamamını doğal ve kısa biçimde karşılar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sahiplik ekiyle bir kişinin elde etmek ya da gerçekleşmesini görmek istediği şey anlatıldığında kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dilekle yakınlığın yanında, dileğin açık bir isteğe dönüşmüş olduğu özellikle belirtilmek istendiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dileğe yakınlığı ve bunun yalnızca tasarı olarak kalmayıp istek konusu olmasını birlikte korur.
Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesine yönelik arzu ve beklenti yönünü korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir türemiş kuruluşu, başka bir kişinin isteğini veya gereksinimini karşılamak anlamında açıkça tanımlar. Dal, istekte bulunma eylemini ya da istenen şeyi değil, isteğe cevap veren kişinin gerçekleştirdiği karşılama sonucunu merkez alır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kökün genel anlamına yayılmaz; yalnızca tanıklanan türemiş ifadede bir başkasının isteğini veya gereksinimini karşılama anlamını verir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal karşılıklı soru yöneltmeyi gerektirir; tek kişinin başkasına yönelttiği ve karşı taraftan soru gelmeyen kullanım genel sorma dalında kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, tanıklanan biçimin yalın dal anlamını karşılıklı soru yöneltme olarak verir ve başka konuşma alışverişlerini bu anlama katmaz.

concept_map.definition: İki veya daha çok kişinin birbirlerine soru yöneltmesi, böylece her birinin ötekine göre soran ve kendisine sorulan konumlarına girmesidir. Yalnızca tek yönlü bir soru bu karşılıklılık koşulunu karşılamaz.

facets.statement: Birden çok katılımcının birbirlerine soru yöneltmesini ve soru rollerini karşılıklı üstlenmesini bildirir.
Eylem, yalnızca aynı ortamda soru sorulmasını değil, soruların katılımcılar arasında karşılıklı yönelmesini gerektirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, biçimi kişilerin birbirlerine soru sorması olarak açıklar. Bu açıklama, genel soru eylemine karşılıklı katılım ve rollerin katılımcılar arasında değişmesi koşulunu ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: İki veya daha çok katılımcının soruları karşılıklı olarak birbirlerine yönelttiği dal çekirdeğinin tamamı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Soru eylemini, katılımcı çokluğunu ve soruların karşılıklı yönelmesini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Katılımcıların birbirlerinden bilgi almak amacıyla sırayla veya karşılıklı soru yönelttiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı soru yöneltmeyi ve bu yolla bilgi edinme amacını bağlam içinde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Katılımcıların birbirlerine soru yöneltmesini ve rollerin karşılıklı olmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tek yönlü soru veya istek için karşı taraftan benzer bir yöneliş gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın merkezinde bir muhataba soru yöneltme eylemi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel sormaya karşılıklılık koşulu ekler: katılımcılar birbirlerine soru yöneltir. Komşu dalda tek bir soranın tek yönlü eylemi anlamın kurulması için yeterlidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Karşılıklı eylemin birimleri özellikle sorulardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Katılımcıların bir konu üzerinde birlikte ilerlemesi, konuşması veya görüş alışverişi yapması soru bulunmadan da gerçekleşebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da birden çok konuşanın aynı konuda karşılıklı iletişim kurmasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda tarafların birbirlerine soru yöneltmesi zorunludur. Komşu dal karşılıklı konuşma ve bir konuyu birlikte ele alma sürecidir; soru-cevap yapısı onun kurucu koşulu değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her katılımcının ötekine soru yöneltmesini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Söze, soruya veya çağrıya cevap vermeyi ve konuşmanın geri dönüşünü öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de konuşanlar arasında gidip gelen söz ve bilgi alışverişi içinde gerçekleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kurucu eylemi sorudur ve karşılıklılık soruların yönünde bulunur. Komşu dal ise verilen cevabı, sözün geri çevrilmesini ve daha geniş diyalog sürecini kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Söz sırasından bağımsız olarak katılımcıların birbirlerine soru yöneltmesini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir konuşanın susup ötekinin konuşmasına dayalı sıra değişimini anlatır; söylenenlerin soru olması gerekmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da birden çok kişinin söz alıp birbirine yöneldiği konuşma alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal soru türünü ve karşılıklı yönelmeyi tanımlar; komşu dal konuşma sırasının el değiştirmesini tanımlar. Karşılıklı sorular eşzamanlı bir alışverişte bulunabilir, sırayla konuşma ise sorusuz da olabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar incelendi; karşılıklı soru koşulunu genel sorma, görüşme, cevaplaşma ve sırayla konuşmadan ayıran dört komşu seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden nazikçe ve belli etmeden çekip çıkarma eylemini doğrudan verir. Kılıcı kınından çekme ile hamurdan kıl ayıklama bu çekirdek işlemin özel uygulamalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, izinli ya da izinsiz almaya değil, ayırıp çıkarma biçimine odaklanır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel çekip çıkarma eylemini kapsar; kılıç ve hamur kalıplarını bu genel anlamın özel uygulamaları olarak ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeyin içinden ya da üzerinden nazikçe ve fark ettirmeden çekerek ayırıp çıkarmaktır.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi bağlı veya kapalı bulunduğu yerden çekerek ayırıp çıkarma işlemi vardır.
Kılıcın kınından çekilmesi ve hamurdaki kılın ayıklanması bu işlemin somut örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bir şeyi başka bir şeyden çekerek çıkarmadır; anlatım bu işlemin incelikli ve gizli yapılabildiğini de korur.

concept_gloss.text: nazikçe ve fark ettirmeden çekip çıkarma
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin bulunduğu yerden incelikle ayrılıp çıkarıldığı dalın tamamı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çekme, ayırma, çıkarma, incelik ve gizlilik özelliklerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesnenin bir yerden incelikle çıkarıldığı genel eylem bağlamlarında doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Çekerek çıkarma işlemini ve incelikli yapılış biçimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Eylemin fark ettirmeden yapılması koşulunu tek başına açıkça belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hamurdan kıl gibi istenmeyen bir parçanın ayrıldığı somut ayıklama bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir parçayı bulunduğu maddeden ayırıp çıkarma işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kılıç gibi kapalı bir yerden çekilen nesneleri ve gizlilik özelliğini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her tür nesnenin bulunduğu maddeden ya da kaptan incelikle çıkarılmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnızca kılıcın kınından çekilmesini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir nesne, içinde bulunduğu kapalı yerden çekilerek çıkarılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal kılıç ve kın ilişkisine özgüdür; odak dal ise aynı çıkarma düzenini hamurdaki kıl gibi başka nesnelere de uygular.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı açıkça gizli hırsızlık ve evden hırsızlık amacıyla alma olarak tanımlar. Rüşvet yalnızca bir biçimin ek kullanımında geçer ve dalın hırsızlık çekirdeğini değiştirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sıradan çekip çıkarmadan suç amacı ve gizlilik koşuluyla ayrılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım türemiş biçimlerdeki gizli hırsızlık alanına bağlıdır; bu alan yalın çekip çıkarma anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi, özellikle bir evden, gizlice ve hırsızlık amacıyla almaktır.

facets.statement: Alma eylemi gizli yapılır ve hırsızlık niteliği taşır.
Bir kaynak birleşiminde aynı biçim hırsızlığın yanında rüşvetle de ilişkilendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım gizli hırsızlığı merkeze alır; birleşik kaynak ifadesi, bir biçim için rüşvetle bağlantılı daha geniş bir kullanımı da bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gizlilik ve hırsızlık amacı taşıyan alma eyleminin çekirdek karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem gizli yapılışı hem de izinsiz alma ve hırsızlık niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin evden hırsızlık yoluyla alındığı açık bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gizli alma eylemini ve hırsızlık amacını eksiksiz korur.
error_profile.loses: Ev dışındaki gizli hırsızlık bağlamlarını kapsam dışında bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kullanımın birlikte bildirildiği özel biçimi açıklamak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Gizli hırsızlık çekirdeğini ve bildirilen yan kullanımı birlikte gösterir.
error_profile.adds: Dalın genel çekirdeğinde zorunlu olmayan rüşvet kullanımını ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hırsızlığı gizlilik ve fark ettirmeden alma yönüyle sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Almayı hız, kapıp kaçma ve kimi zaman zor kullanma yönüyle tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da başkasına ait bir şeyi izinsiz alma alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı koşulu gizliliktir; komşu dalda belirleyici özellik hızlı kapma veya zorlayıcı biçimde el koymadır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; gizli hırsızlık ile hızlı kapıp alma karşıtlığı okuyucu için en yararlı sınırı sağlar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السلة والإسلال بمعنى السرقة الخفية وما قاربها من أخذ الشيء من البيت على وجه السرقة

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çocuk ve hayvan yavrusunu, ayrıca bir kökten çekilip alınan öz ya da üreme maddesini aynı çıkış ilişkisi altında toplar. Dal kullanılabilir, ancak bütün öğelerin doğrudan soy anlamına gelmediği açıkça belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ortaklık, bir kökenden çıkmış olma ilişkisidir; kişi soyu ile maddi öz birbirine eşitlenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım türemiş adların kökenden çıkma ortaklığını verir; yavru ve maddi öz kullanımlarını ayrı alt alanlar olarak korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kökenden çıkan çocuk ya da yavruyu veya bir ana maddeden çekilip ayrılan özü anlatır; ortak çekirdek, kökenden ayrılarak meydana gelmedir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın kendi kökeninden çıkması veya ondan türemesi temel ilişkidir.
İnsan çocuğu ile erkek ve dişi at yavrusu, canlı kökenden çıkan varlıklar olarak adlandırılır.
Bir şeyden çekilip alınan öz ve insanın üreme maddesi aynı köken ilişkisine dayalı maddi kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşik kaynak anlatımı, çocuk ve yavru ile kök maddeden ayrılan öz arasında kökenden çıkma bağı kurar; canlı soy ve maddi öz kapsamları ayrı tutulur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Canlı soy ile bir ana maddeden ayrılmış özü ortak köken ilişkisi altında birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kökenden çıkma ilişkisini, yavru alanını ve maddi öz alanını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın doğrudan çocuğunun kökenden çıkışı vurgulandığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Canlı kökenden doğan insan yavrusu ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Hayvan yavrusunu ve bir maddeden ayrılan öz kullanımını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Erkek ya da dişi at yavrusunun adlandırıldığı hayvan bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: At yavrusunun canlı kökeninden çıkması ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: İnsan çocuğunu ve maddi öz kullanımını kapsam dışı bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir ana maddeden çekilip alınan öz veya üreme maddesi anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir kökenden ayrılarak çıkan maddi özü korur.
error_profile.loses: Çocuk ve hayvan yavrusu anlamlarını kapsam dışı bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Canlı yavrunun yanında bir ana maddeden ayrılan özü de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Soyun kuşaklar boyunca sürmesi ve üreme amacıyla yetiştirilen hayvanları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir canlıdan doğan çocuk veya yavruyu ve soy ilişkisini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kökenden çekilip çıkmış tek yavruyu ve maddi özü öne çıkarır; komşu dal soyun çoğalması ve kuşaklar boyunca sürmesiyle daha geniştir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dar bir yerden, kalabalıktan veya insanların arasından çıkıp gitmeyi açıkça bildirir. Gizlice ve siperlenerek ayrılma, bu çıkışın bağlamsal yapılış biçimidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, elde tutulan bir nesneyi çıkarmayı değil, hareket eden öznenin aradan ayrılmasını anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım türemiş çıkış biçimlerini ve insanlar arasından çıkma kalıbını birlikte kapsar; bunları genel nesne çıkarma anlamıyla karıştırmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir öznenin dar bir yerden, kalabalıktan veya insanların arasından sıyrılarak çıkıp gitmesidir.

facets.statement: Hareket eden özne, çevresindeki sıkışık yerden ya da topluluktan dışarı çıkar.
Topluluktan gizlice ve başkasını siper ederek ayrılma, çıkışın özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dar yerden veya insanların arasından çıkıp gitme üzerinde birleşir; topluluktan gizlice ayrılma bu çekirdeğin özel biçimidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dar bir yerden veya topluluğun arasından hareket ederek ayrılma çekirdeğini doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Öznenin sıkışık çevreden ayrılmasını, çıkışını ve akıcı hareketini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin insanların arasından çıkıp uzaklaştığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsanların arasından akıcı biçimde çıkma eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: İnsan bulunmayan dar yerlerden çıkma kapsamını içermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluktan fark ettirmeden uzaklaşma bağlamında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluktan gizlice çıkıp gitme özelliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Dar yerden açık biçimde çıkma ve aradan sıyrılma kapsamını daraltır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir özne bulunduğu iç konumdan dışarıya geçer.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel çıkışı bildirir; odak dal çıkışın sıkışık bir aralıktan veya topluluğun içinden sıyrılarak gerçekleşmesini şart koşar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, parçaların birbirine bağlanarak bir dizi oluşturmasını çekirdek anlam olarak verir. Demir halkalar, uzayan şimşek ve birbirine eklenen kum kıvrımları bu bağlantı düzeninin somutlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal akıcı suyu değil, parçalar arasında görülen bağlantı ve dizilişi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel bağlantı çekirdeğini verir; şimşek ve kum kalıplarını yalnızca bu çekirdeğin özel görüntüleri olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Parçaların birbirine bağlanarak ardışık ve uzanan bir bütün oluşturmasıdır.

facets.statement: Ayrı parçalar birbirine bağlanır ve bağlantılı bir dizi meydana getirir.
Demir halkalardan oluşan zincir, çekirdek bağlantı yapısının belirgin örneğidir.
Bulut boyunca uzanan şimşek ve birbirine eklenip kıvrılan kum çizgileri benzer görsel bağlantıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, parçaların birbirine bağlı olmasıdır; demir zincir gerçek nesneyi, şimşek ve kum ise bağlantılı uzanışın benzetmeli örneklerini oluşturur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Halkalar, parçalar veya çizgisel bölümlerin bağlantılı bir bütün oluşturduğu dalın tamamına uygulanır.

error_profile.preserves: Parçaların bağlantısını, ardışıklığını ve birlikte uzanan bir bütün oluşturmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birbirine geçmiş demir halkalardan oluşan bilinen nesne için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Birbirine bağlı halkalardan oluşan somut diziyi korur.
error_profile.loses: Şimşek ve kumdaki bağlantılı uzanış gibi benzetmeli uygulamaları kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Parçaların bağlantı içinde olduğu genel niteleme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Parçaların birbirine bağlanması ve bir bütün oluşturması çekirdeğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da zinciri ve parçaların birbirine bağlanarak ardışık bütün oluşturmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdek sınırlar aynıdır; odak daldaki şimşek ve kum örnekleri, ortak bağlantı anlamının bağımlı uygulamalarıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bağlantı ve zincir çekirdeğini tam paylaşan komşu tek doğrudan eş anlamlı olarak yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السلسلة واتصال الشيء بالشيء والحديد والبرق والرمل المتعقد أو الممتد بعضه ببعض
